程的「口語報告」的文稿撰寫，學生應該先自己寫稿，並保留不同版本的文 稿，最後才由生成式 AI 工具或是小老師協助修改。若經查核使用卻無在作業 或報告中標明，教師、學校或相關單位有權重新針對作業或報告重新評分或不 予計分。 2. 本門課授課教材或學習資料若有引用自生成式 AI，教師也將在投影片或口頭標 注。 3. 修讀本課程之學生於選課時視為同意以上倫理聲明。 六 docs.nameEn: Mandarin Phonetics in Chinese as a Second Language
docs.text: 華語作爲第二語言的語音研究 Mandarin Phonetics in Chinese as a Second Language 詳細課綱將在第一週上課發給修課生。 114學年度第ㄧ學期 授課教師：吳貞慧 上課時間：星期二 567 上課地點：人社院 研究室：人社院B515 分機：34425 Email：chenhueiwu@gmail.com Office Hours：以星期二下午2:00-4:00為主或其他時間，請事先預約。 一、 課程概述： 本課程旨在引導華語教學組研究生系統性認識華語作為第二語言之語音習得現象 與相關研究理論。課程內容涵蓋華語語音特性、華語聲調系統、第二語言語音習得理 論（如語音遷移、感知與產出之互動關係）、華語學習者常見語音偏誤類型與成因分 析，並探討不同母語背景學習者之語音表現特徵。 課程將結合理論講授與研究案例分析，培養學生閱讀與評析第二語言語音研究文 獻的能力，並引導學生理解語音習得過程中影響因素（如語音感知、語音模仿、語音 相似性、年齡因素等）。同時，課程將安排實作活動，如簡易語音資料收集與分析練 習，使學生具備初步進行華語語音學習研究之能力。透過本課程，學生將能深化對華 語語音習得現象的理解，為未來從事華語語音教學設計、學習策略輔導及相關學術研 究打下堅實基礎。 二、 指定閱讀： 期刊論文及專書文章等。 三、 參考書目： 1. Ladefoged, Peter. (2001). A Course in Phonetics. Heinle & Heinle, Thomson Learning. 2. Ladefoged, Peter. (2001). Vowels and Consonants: An Introduction to the Sounds of Languages. Blackwell Publishing: Hong Kong. 3. Johnson, Keith. (2003). Acoustic and Auditory Phonetics. Blackwell Publishing: Hong Kong. 4. Ladefoged, Peter and Ian Maddieson. (1996). The Sounds of the World’s Languages. Blackwell Publishing: Hong Kong. 四、 教學方式： 教師講述、學生報告與導讀、課堂討論、案例分析 五、 評分方式： 1. 出席 5% 2. 閱讀文章批判性思考與提問 25% 每週閱讀文章需在 eLearn平台討論區寫讀後反思與提問，第二週開始在平台提問，請 於上課前一天17點以前張貼，該週報告的同學不需要閱讀文章提問，但需要在報告時 引導討論和回應(不一定是報告者要負責回答)同學的提問。 3. 文章報告 20% 每位同學有2次閱讀文章報告與導讀，需要準備投影片，詳細說明該篇論文的研究背景 與動機、研究問題、相關文獻、研究方法和研究結果，文章報告時間為30分鐘，之 後，請根據同學對該篇文章的反思與提問回應與引導討論，約10-15分鐘。 4. 作業：演講心得、案例分析 10% 5. 期末報告 期末報告文獻探討、研究方法、資料收集結果之書面作業 15% 期中文獻探討：根據期末報告要做的題目，期中找五篇相關的文獻閱讀（期末完整報 告至少需有10篇相關文獻），並整理成文獻探討，頁數3-5頁（5%）。 研究方法：需事先與教師討論並具體撰寫研究方法(5%)。 初步資料收集結果：將原始資料收集結果整理並具體說明分析方式(5%)。期中、期末口頭報告 10% 期中口頭報告：題目、研究背景、動機、研究問題、文獻探討和研究方法(5%)。 期末口頭報告：簡述期中報告，將重點放在研究結果與分析，結論回應研究問題 (5%)。期末書面報告 15% 最後一週口頭報告並繳交期末書面報告(不含參考文獻書目)至少12頁，最多20頁。任 何與本課程內容相關的主題皆可，需先與授課教師討論，確定題目符合本課程主旨。 小論文章節包括：一. 緒論、二. 文獻探討、三. 研究方法、四. 結果與討論、五. 結論。 期末書面報告的文獻探討至少包含10篇文獻。最後期末報告繳交時間，待學校通知期 末成績上傳截至日期再定案。 六 、 生 成 式 人 工 智 慧 倫 理 聲 明 有條件開放使用 基於透明與負責任的原則，本課程鼓勵學生利用 AI 進行協作或互學，以提升本門課產 出品質。根據本校公布之「大學教育場域 AI 協作、共學與素養培養指引」，本門課程 docs.text: MFB Program, Autumn 2024 ____ Syllabus: 1 of 2 金融機構策略管理 Strategic management of Financial Institutions -A Corporate Strategic Management Perspective Joseph J. C. Lyu 呂桔誠 Strategic Management of Financial Institutions – A Corporate Strategic Management Perspective (金融機構策略管理) is a lecture course with active class participation, in form of discussion, group study and presentation, by students. Whilst non-deposit-taking financial institutions will be touched on a selective basis, the course stresses the conceptual foundation of Banking together with the idiosyncrasies of those credit markets dominated by deposit-taking financial institutions. Recent developments with potentially far-reaching implications for the future design of banking and financial markets are addressed. The course focuses on the environmental dynamics against which bank management decisions and strategies must be taken on or formulated, rather than operational practices per se. Distinguished experts will be invited to give speeches on selected topics and share their field experiences. Students without finance background will particularly benefit from the opportunities of understanding the financiers’ thinking and decision-making rationale and interacting with the classmates with finance background. Topics 1. Overview on Financial Services Industry 2. Environment: Deregulations & Globalization 3. Business Borrowings & Loan Syndication 4. Capital Markets & Instruments 5. Money Markets & Instruments 6. Foreign Exchange Markets & Instruments 7. Derivative Markets & Instruments 8. Risk Management: Credit Risk, Interest Rate Risk, Currency Risk, etc. 9. Financial Innovations & Applications 10. Securitization 11. Expansion Strategy: Merger & Acquisition vs. Organic Growth 12. Financial Institutions: Commercial Banks 13. Financial Institutions: Securities Firms/ Asset Management Firms 14. Financial Institutions: Investment Banking 15. Wrap-up Syllabus: 2 of 2 Grading Policy Class participation 50% Group study & report 50% Group Study & Reporting - Students are expected to form study groups before the 3rd week - Each group consists of 3 to 4 persons, preferably mixed with finance and non-finance background. - Each group picks one financial institution or instrument to examine its market and/or performance. - Each group will present its study in a class meeting as designated. - The final report in form of PPT presentation is to include: . Introduction . Background . Current status/ costs & benefits/ risks involved . Potential problems/ issues/ challenges . Solutions or strategies being adopted .Your recommended strategy reorientation and/or needed actions . References

docs.text:
課程目標 Course objectives
本課程的設計目的是為了讓學員了解更多的機器與統計學習技巧，以協助處理相關的財務問題。課程中還會以銀行自動核貸系統為例，說明如何利用統計技巧來協助銀行進行相關的核貸業務。並且，希望透過本次課程，讓學員具備團隊合作的精神與有效溝通的能力，以培養跨領域工作的技能。

課程說明 Course Description
本課程主要是介紹基本的機器與統計學習 (如關聯性分析，分類，預測等模型)，再利用 R 的相關套件，以實際例子進行相關的財務應用 (如 peer to peer lending…)。學員具備相關知識以後，會再介紹自動核貸系統的設計概念與其它金融創新的相關應用。

指定用書 Textbooks
An Introduction to Statistical Learning with Application in R, 2013, Springer
By Gareth James, Daniela Witten, Trevor Hastie and Robert Tibshirani

報告 100%

docs.text: National Tsing Hua University College of Technology Management Course Syllabus 課堂小次驗 MFB501600 學分 Credit 3 人數限制 Size of Limit 中文名稱 Course Title 資產抵押融資 英文名稱 Course English Title (必填) Asset-Based Finance 任課教師 Instructor 林哲群 教師聯絡方式 Contact Information chclin@mx.nthu.edu.tw 上課時間 Time 上課教室 Room 先修科目 Prerequisite(s) None 本課程對應之學習目標與核心能力 Aligned Learning Goals and Learning Objectives 藉由此課程，使同學對證券化融資有一定程度上的認知與了解，並檢視其如何在市場上 運作以及進行時所會產生的問題與差異。 課程目標 Course Objectives 透過本課程，希望讓未來財金領域的專業人士： 透過對證券化融資的了解，使貸放市場與證券市場有效結合，進而提升資金運用效率。 同時深化理解以資產本深信用作為融資與否之考量，將會促進資金配置效率的提升。強 化研發創新金融商品，拓展金融業務能力，協助金融機構分散風險，提升經營績效。藉 由此課程，協助財經專業的人士在上述這些議題上，更能有所助益。 課程說明 Course Description 證券化融資，簡單的說是指金融機構或公司將所持有的各種資產轉換成證券流通於市 場，也就是說，將各種資產藉由轉換的過程與資本市場緊密的結合，然後進一步促使資 產的流通性更為活絡，如此一來社會整體資金的運用將會更有效率化。本課程將探討幾 種主要的資產證券化融資類型及其之架構。藉由此課程，使同學對資產證券化有一定程 度上的認知及了解。 指定用書 Textbooks 上課講義及指定的參考書單 National Tsing Hua University College of Technology Management Course Syllabus 參考書籍 References ＴＢＡ 教學方式 Teaching Approach 教師講解、課中討論、融資個案分析及模擬 評分標準 Grading 課堂參與及小測驗、期末個案報告(書面、口頭)、project 教學進度 Course Schedule 主軸架構將包含下列：(for details, please refer to course syllabus) 證券化融資導論 資產抵押融資架構 資產抵押融資商品 群募平台融資 資產抵押融資 Project Simulation 其他相關議題 邀請兩位業師演講 課程相關連接 Course Related Links None

docs.text:
課程說明：
1.「全民國防教育—防衛動員」課程設立之目的，在使大學生瞭解「國家安全、人人有責」之意涵，未來均
能成為國家良好之現代公民，並積極承擔國家防衛之責任。防衛動員是指一個國家在面臨戰爭或緊急狀態
時，
動員徵集民間人力、物力及財力資源以進行戰爭準備及應變工作。由於戰爭所需動員人力規模非常龐大，物
力
徵集項目也非常繁雜，財源募集困難，必須在平時就建構一套完整及周密的動員體系，才能在最短的時間內
補
充戰爭損耗，有效維持應有戰力，並贏得戰爭的勝利。
2.是故本課程即是以「全民國防」為核心價值，而在結構上，則是以動員機制、世界主要國家防衛動員作
法，我國動員體制與法令、個人基礎防衛，作為課程講授及討論重點。
3.大綱：防衛動員基本概念/防衛動員與全民國防/我國防衛動員簡介/防衛動員與緊急應變/災害防救與動
員/災害防救知能/災害防救、災防整備/防身術教學
4.課程中可能有身體接觸，如有顧慮請勿選本課程!!!

教學方式：
以課堂講授、分組操作、報告交互進行。

成績考核：
課堂參與（含出席狀況）：40%
期中成績（分組報告）：30%
期末考試：30%

生成式人工智慧倫理聲明：禁止使用

1.經仔細考量後，本課程授課教師認為不宜於此門課程當中使用生成式人工智慧於課堂學習當中。因本課
程的內容於生成式AI中尚有諸多錯誤，且容易影響學生對基礎核心知識之判讀。
2.根據本校公布之佈的「大學教育場域AI協作、共學與素養培養指引」，本門課程採取禁止使用，以下為
相關的監管機制：
(1)修讀本門課程之學生應注意本門課不得繳交使用生成式人工智慧所產出的作業、報告或個人心得。若經
查核發現，教師、學校或相關單位有權重新針對作業或報告重新評分或不予計分。
(2)修讀本課程之學生於選課時視為同意以上倫理聲明。

特別說明：
1.本課程可折抵役期，可計算為學期學分，但不納入畢業學分。
2.課程中可能有身體接觸，如有顧慮請勿選本課程!!!

力
徵集項目也非常繁雜，財源募集困難，必須在平時就建構一套完整及周密的動員體系，才能在最短的時間內
補
充戰爭損耗，有效維持應有戰力，並贏得戰爭的勝利。
2.是故本課程即是以「全民國防」為核心價值，而在結構上，則是以動員機制、世界主要國家防衛動員作
法，我國動員體制與法令、個人基礎防衛，作為課程講授及討論重點。
3.大綱：防衛動員基本概念/防衛動員與全民國防/我國防衛動員簡介/防衛動員與緊急應變/災害防救與動
員/災害防救知能/災害防救、災防整備/防身術教學
4.課程中可能有身體接觸，如有顧慮請勿選本課程!!!

教學方式：
以課堂講授、分組操作、報告交互進行。

成績考核：
課堂參與（含出席狀況）：40%
期中成績（分組報告）：30%
期末考試：30%

生成式人工智慧倫理聲明：禁止使用

1.經仔細考量後，本課程授課教師認為不宜於此門課程當中使用生成式人工智慧於課堂學習當中。因本課
程的內容於生成式AI中尚有諸多錯誤，且容易影響學生對基礎核心知識之判讀。
2.根據本校公布之佈的「大學教育場域AI協作、共學與素養培養指引」，本門課程採取禁止使用，以下為
相關的監管機制：
(1)修讀本門課程之學生應注意本門課不得繳交使用生成式人工智慧所產出的作業、報告或個人心得。若經
查核發現，教師、學校或相關單位有權重新針對作業或報告重新評分或不予計分。
(2)修讀本課程之學生於選課時視為同意以上倫理聲明。

特別說明：
1.本課程可折抵役期，可計算為學期學分，但不納入畢業學分。
2.課程中可能有身體接觸，如有顧慮請勿選本課程!!!

●國防法(軍政、軍令一元化)
●國防部組織法
●全民防衛動員準備法

docs.text: 國立清華大學 114 學年度第 1 學期課程大綱 科號 Course Number 11410MPMI 學分 Credit 3 人數限制 Class Size 20 中文名稱 Course Title 醫學資訊學 英文名稱 Course English Title Medical Informatics 任課教師 Instructor 趙恒勝、林敬恒、劉德明 上課時間 Time T2T3T4 上課教室 Room 生一 112 課程簡述(必填) (最多 500 個中文字) 本欄位資料會上傳教育部課程網 Brief Course Description (required) (50-200 words if possible, up to 1000 letters) 介紹醫學資訊領域的研究範圍。學生將學習如何獲取、處理醫學信息。課程將教授資訊科學和 醫學的相關理論，並介紹資訊科技在醫學上的各種應用。 課程內容「中文暨英文關鍵字」(必填) 至少 5 個,每個關鍵字至多 20 個中文,以半形逗點分隔 Please fill in at least 5 course keywords (up to 40 letters for each keyword) and use commas to separate them.(required) 醫學資訊是科學也是語用學 (Medical Informatics: the Science and the Pragmatics), 醫學照護系統的軟硬體架構 (Computer Architecture and Software Engineering in Health Care), 醫學資訊標準 (Standards in Medical Informatics, 醫學影像學 (Medical Imaging Informatics), 醫療照護的自然語言處理 (Natural Language Processing in Health Care), 課程大綱(必填)Detailed Course Syllabus ● 課程說明(Course Description) 這門課是針對來自醫學領域和資訊領域的跨領域學生，所開設的一門課，主要是了解醫學資訊 目前所包含的主題和實際應用的領域。 ● 指定用書(Text Books) Biomedical Informatics: Computer Applications in Health Care and Biomedicine Edward H. Shortliffe and James J. Cimino Springer-Verlag New York, Inc., 5th Edition ● 參考書籍(References) 網路上的參考資料 ● 教學方式(Teaching Method) 課堂授課與學生分組報告 ● 教學進度(Syllabus) 1. Biomedical Informatics: The Science and the Pragmatics 2. Biomedical Data: Their Acquisition, Storage, and Use 3. Human-Computer Interaction, Usability, and Workflow 4. Software Engineering for Health Care and Biomedicine 5. Standards in Biomedical Informatics 6. Natural Language Processing for Health-- Related Texts 7. Biomedical Imaging Informatics 8. Personal Health Informatics 9. Evaluation of Biomedical and Health Information Resources 10. Electronic Health Record Systems 11. Patient-Centered Care Systems 12. Public Health Informatics 13. mHealth and Applications 14. Telemedicine and Telehealth 15. Clinical Research Informatics 16. Precision Medicine and Informatics ● 成績考核(Evaluation) 1. 平時報告 40% 2. 期末專題報告 60% ● 採用下列何項 AI 使用規則(Indicate which of the following options you use to manage student use of the AI) (1) 完全開放使用且無須註明 Unrestricted use with no disclosure required (2) 有條件開放，請註明如何使用生成式 AI 於課程產出 Conditionally open; please specify how generative AI will be used in course output (3) 禁止使用，請註明相關的監管機制 Prohibited use; please specify relevant oversight (4) 本課程無涉及 AI 使用 Not applicable 可參考下列網頁範例 See the following web page for examples. https://curricul.site.nthu.edu.tw/p/404-1208-248357.php?Lang=zh-tw ● 可連結之網頁位址 相關網頁(Personal Website)

docs.text: 國立清華大學 114 學年度第 1 學期課程大綱 科號 Course Number 11410MPMI 學分 Credit 2 人數限制 Class Size 20 中文名稱 Course Title 醫學資訊標準與互通 英文名稱 Course English Title Standards and Interoperability of Medical Informatics 任課教師 Instructor 劉德明 上課時間 Time W5W6 上課教室 Room 生二 321 課程簡述(必填) (最多 500 個中文字) 本欄位資料會上傳教育部課程網 Brief Course Description (required) (50-200 words if possible, up to 1000 letters) 醫學資訊標準是健康資料互通的一個重要關鍵，沒有遵循標準的資料無法共享，除了造成資源 的浪費外，也造成無法有足沒有足夠的資料來訓練 AI 模型，對未來影響巨大。因此，這門課 介紹給跨領域的學生，學習如何遵循標準建置醫療信息系統。 課程內容「中文暨英文關鍵字」(必填) 至少 5 個,每個關鍵字至多 20 個中文,以半形逗點分隔 Please fill in at least 5 course keywords (up to 40 letters for each keyword) and use commas to separate them.(required) 醫療資訊互通 (Interoperability of Medical Informatics), 隱私(Privacy), 資訊參考模型 (Reference Information Model), 健康資訊第七層 (Health Level 7), 編碼與分類 (Coding and Classification), 課程大綱(必填)Detailed Course Syllabus ● 課程說明(Course Description) 這門課是針對來自醫學領域和資訊領域的跨領域學生，所開設的一門課，主要是了解醫學資訊 領域的標準與如何應用標準。 ● 指定用書(Text Books) Principles of Health Interoperability HL7 and SNOMED Tim Benson Springer, 2th Edition ● 參考書籍(References) 網路上的參考資料 ● 教學方式(Teaching Method) 課堂授課與學生分組報告 ● 教學進度(Syllabus) 1. The Health Information Revolution 2. Models：UML and XML 3. Privacy 4. Standards Development Organizations 5. HL7 Version 2 6. The HL7 V3 RIM (1) 7. The HL7 V3 RIM (2) 8. Constrained Information Models 9. Clinical Document Architecture 10. HL7 Dynamic Model 11. IHE XDS 12. Clinical Terminology 13. Coding and Classification Scheme 14. SNOMED CT 15. SNOMED CT Concept Model 16. Using SNOMED and HL7 Together ● 成績考核(Evaluation) 1. 平時報告 40% 2. 期末專題報告 60% ● 採用下列何項 AI 使用規則(Indicate which of the following options you use to manage student use of the AI) (1) 完全開放使用且無須註明 Unrestricted use with no disclosure required (2) 有條件開放，請註明如何使用生成式 AI 於課程產出 Conditionally open; please specify how generative AI will be used in course output (3) 禁止使用，請註明相關的監管機制 Prohibited use; please specify relevant oversight (4) 本課程無涉及 AI 使用 Not applicable 可參考下列網頁範例 See the following web page for examples. https://curricul.site.nthu.edu.tw/p/404-1208-248357.php?Lang=zh-tw ● 可連結之網頁位址 相關網頁(Personal Website)

docs.name: 生物統計
docs.text: 國立清華大學 114 學年度第 1 學期課程大綱 科號 Course Number 11410MPMI 學分 Credit 3 人數限制 Class Size 20 中文名稱 Course Title 生物統計 英文名稱 Course English Title Biostatistics 任課教師 Instructor 施銘杰 上課時間 Time W7W8R5 上課教室 Room 生二 220 課程簡述(必填) (最多 500 個中文字) 本欄位資料會上傳教育部課程網 Brief Course Description (required) (50-200 words if possible, up to 1000 letters) 本課程主要受眾為對生物醫學資料之統計分析有興趣的研究所學生。課程前半部將著重建 立統計觀念、介紹推論統計所需的數學工具、以及講授推論統計的邏輯基礎。後半部則將 針對各種資料型態介紹常用的統計檢定及回歸方法，並輔以因果推論的理論框架，讓學生 能夠針對有興趣的研究議題，選擇適當的統計方法進行資料分析後，正確解讀分析結果並 給出結論。課程並附有電腦實作課，以供學生實地演練生物醫學資料之統計分析。 課程內容「中文暨英文關鍵字」(必填) 至少 5 個,每個關鍵字至多 20 個中文,以半形逗點分隔 Please fill in at least 5 course keywords (up to 40 letters for each keyword) and use commas to separate them.(required) 生物統計（Biostatistics）；描述性統計（Descriptive statistics）；推論性統計 （Inferential statistics）；假說檢定（Hypothesis testing）；區間估計（Interval estimation）；迴歸分析（Regression analysis） 課程大綱(必填)Detailed Course Syllabus ● 課程說明(Course Description) This course will be conducted in English. It is designed for graduate students interested in statistical analysis of biomedical data. There are no pre-requisites for this course. In the first part of the course, we will look into the theoretical foundation of statistics and demonstrate how descriptive and inferential statistics can facilitate data summarization and evidence generation. In the second part, we will introduce hypothesis tests and regression models commonly used in biomedical literature. We will elaborate on how to choose between the tests and models based on the question and data at hand, to interpret the analysis results and draw conclusions. We will also introduce the conceptual framework of causal inference and demonstrate how regression models can help us estimate the causal effect of interest. There will be several computer laboratory tutorials using R to carry out the analyses described in the lectures. ● 指定用書(Text Books) Class handouts with related references ● 參考書籍(References) Triola, M. M., Triola, M. F., & Roy, J. (2017). Biostatistics for the biological and health sciences (2nd ed.). Upper Saddle River, NJ: Pearson ● 教學方式(Teaching Method) In-class lectures, and statistical package tutorials ● 教學進度(Syllabus) 1 Introduction to biostatistics and R 2 Descriptive statistics 3 Probability and distributions 4 Sampling distribution and central limit theorem 5 Interval estimation and hypothesis testing 6 Inference from one sample 7 Inference from two samples 8 Midterm exam 9 Correlation and simple linear regression 10 Multiple linear regression and ANOVA 11 Causal inference / Non-parametric inference 12 Inferences from contingency tables 13 Generalized linear models 14 Logistic regression and Poisson regression 15 Survival analysis 16 Final exam ● 成績考核(Evaluation) In-class performance (10%) Assignments (30%) Midterm exam (30%) Final exam (30%) ● 採用下列何項 AI 使用規則(Indicate which of the following options you use to manage student use of the AI) 有條件開放，請註明如何使用生成式 AI 於課程產出 Conditionally open; please specify how generative AI will be used in course output ● 可連結之網頁位址 相關網頁(Personal Website)

docs.name: 基礎醫學概論
docs.text: 國立清華大學 114 學年度第 1 學期課程大綱 科號 Course Number 11410MPMI120200 學分 Credit 3 人數限制 Class Size 20 中文名稱 Course Title 基礎醫學概論 英文名稱 Course English Title Fundamentals of Basic Medicine 任課教師 Instructor 莊永仁 陳子福 施銘杰 上課時間 Time W2W3W4 上課教室 Room 生二 113 本研究生課程主要為醫學資訊碩士學位學程中非生醫背景的學生所開設，由醫學系教師介紹基 礎醫學知識，同時也適合對智慧健康領域有興趣的跨領域學生修習。 在本課程中，學生將學習使用線上資源、AI 工具及 PubMed 等資料庫，開展自主且持續的醫 學知識學習。課程內容從人體生理學、解剖學的基礎概念開始，轉入醫學專業術語、診斷檢查 及疾病、病理生理學等入門講演；隨著學習進展，學生將進一步探討以心血管疾病、癌症、神 經系統疾病、傳染病及代謝疾病…等常見疾病為主題的專題模組學習，進而探索 smart health 的實務議題。透過參與實作練習與針對真實健康醫療的案例研討，學生將在期末專題中，構思 所學醫學見解與跨領域解決方案，從而培養迎戰當代醫療健康挑戰的能力。 課程內容「中文暨英文關鍵字」(必填) 至少 5 個,每個關鍵字至多 20 個中文,以半形逗點分隔 基礎醫學知識、智慧醫療、疾病、治療、跨域思考 Basic Medical knowledge, Smart Health, Disease, Treatment, Interdisciplinary thinking 課程大綱(必填)Detailed Course Syllabus ● 課程說明(Course Description) This graduate course provides a foundational introduction to medical knowledge for students who previously majored in fields outside of biomedical sciences within the 醫學資訊碩士學位學 程. It is designed to equip students with essential knowledge and to initiate a self-directed learning path that will enhance their ability to interpret clinical reports, understand disease mechanisms, and explore smart health technologies. As smart health solutions increasingly impact modern medicine, professionals in medical informatics must develop a robust understanding of fundamental medical concepts to contribute effectively to this dynamic field. The course begins with a brief overview of human anatomy and physiology, along with guidance on utilizing online tools and resources to enhance self-directed learning in medical knowledge. In the following weeks, students will be introduced to fundamental medical terminology and the analysis of clinical reports. They will then explore evidence-based medicine and medical informatics, gaining an understanding of the role of clinical guidelines and decision-support tools in healthcare. The course transitions to modules focused on various diseases and practical issues, including cardiovascular diseases, cancer, neurological disorders, infectious diseases, metabolic disorders...etc. Each disease module includes hands-on exploration of health technologies. Students will also gain insights into clinical trials and drug development, discussing how big data, artificial intelligence, and cloud computing can transform medical research and application. Ethical and security concerns will also be addressed. The course culminates in a capstone project, where students integrate their acquired medical knowledge into a real-world application. This project encourages interdisciplinary thinking and fosters problem-solving skills in the field of smart healthcare innovation. ● 指定用書(Text Books) None ● 參考書籍(References) Selected e-books of medical textbooks, articles from current medical literature, clinical reports, guidelines…; and information related to Smart Health Taiwan (www.hst.org.tw) case studies. ● 教學方式(Teaching Method) Lectures, Discussions, Hands-on exercises, Presentation 條件式英語授課: 待開學加退選後無外籍生修課，再予評估調整為中文授課。 ● 教學進度(Syllabus) • Week 1: Introduction to Human Physiology & Anatomy o Basic structure and function of the human body o Develop self-learning strategies for exploring medical knowledge • Week 2: Principles of Disease and Pathophysiology o Mechanisms of disease (inflammation, infection, cancer, etc.) o Key biomarkers in diagnostics o Hands-on: Comparing different disease presentations • Week 3: Medical Terminology and Understanding Clinical Reports o Reading and interpreting medical records o Common diagnostic tests (e.g., blood work, imaging, Echo, etc.) o Hands-on: Reading sample clinical reports • Week 4: Introduction to Evidence-Based Medicine o Clinical guidelines and their role in healthcare o Decision-making on treatment/drug approaches o Hands-on: Choose a prevalent disease and search for treatment/drug information • Week 5: Neurological Disorders o Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, and stroke rehabilitation o Brain imaging and predictive analytics o Hands-on: Exploring brain imaging datasets • Week 6: Infectious Diseases & Pandemic o COVID-19, tuberculosis, and antimicrobial resistance o Epidemic surveillance and telemedicine applications o Hands-on: what is pandemic data analysis? • Week 7: Cardiovascular Diseases & Monitoring o Hypertension, coronary artery disease, and stroke o techniques for heart monitoring (ECG, blood pressure tracking) o Hands-on: what is CVD risk assessment? • Week 8: Cancer and Precision Medicine o Basics of oncology, tumor markers, and treatment modalities o Genetic profiling & epigenetics, RNAs… o Hands-on: Review clinical reports related to cancer • Week 9: Metabolic Disorders o Diabetes and obesity o Apps for glucose monitoring, TEDD… o Hands-on: Evaluating diabetes management applications • Week 10: Geriatric Medicine o Common aging-related diseases: Osteoporosis, arthritis, dementia, cardiovascular decline o Geriatric syndromes: Frailty, polypharmacy, falls, and cognitive impairment o Hands-on: Analyzing aging-related biomarkers and risk factors in clinical reports • Week 11: Mental Disorders o Common mental health conditions: Depression, anxiety, schizophrenia, and bipolar disorder o Diagnostic and treatment approaches: Psychological assessments, neuroimaging, and pharmacological vs. non-pharmacological interventions o Hands-on: Exploring mental health apps and digital therapy tools (e.g., CBT-based apps, AI-driven mood tracking) • Week 12: Clinical Trials and Drug Development o Phases of clinical trials & regulatory considerations o Real world evidence (RWE) and post-marketing surveillance o ABC’s role in drug discovery (AI, Big data, Cloud computing) • Week 13: Emerging Health Threats and Smart Healthcare Trends o Personalized medicine and gene editing o Robotics (automation) in healthcare o Hands-on: Sample smart health applications; Wearable devices • Week 14: Security & Ethical Issues in Digital Health o Data privacy, security threats in health informatics o Ethical considerations in healthcare; IRB • Week 15: Final Project Presentation 1/2 o Students present their findings on their chosen prevalent disease; present solutions leveraging Engineering and/or informatics technologies; Focus on integrating smart health applications • Week 16: Final Project Presentation 2/2 & Future Outlook in Medical Informatics o Students' presentation continued o Course wrap-up and discussion on emerging medical informatics trends ● 成績考核(Evaluation) Class Participation & Discussions – 20% Quizzes (Medical Reports & Terminology) – 20% Hands-on Assignments & Case Studies – 30% Final Project (Prevalent Disease & Smart Health Solution) – 30% 採用下列何項 AI 使用規則 (Indicate which of the following options you use to manage student use of the AI) 有條件開放，請註明如何使用生成式 AI 於課程產出 Conditionally open; please specify how generative AI will be used in course output 說明: 本課程鼓勵學生在透明與負責的原則下，適度使用 AI 工具進行課業協作。學生應 (1)在作業或報告的標題頁註明，且(2)於引用文獻部分簡要說明 AI 工具的使用情況，並 (3)遵循學校的相關指引 (請查詢: http://ctld.nthu.edu.tw/; 教學發展中心-辦法表單)。如未 明確依此規則標註與說明，教師有權重新評分或不予計分。 ● 可連結之網頁位址 相關網頁(Personal Website) NTHU eeclass https://eeclass.nthu.edu.tw

docs.text: 國立清華大學 114 學年度第 1 學期課程大綱 科號 Course Number 11410MPMI 學分 Credit 3 人數限制 Class Size 30 中文名稱 Course Title 程式設計 英文名稱 Course English Title Programming 任課教師 Instructor 郭柏志 上課時間 Time F2F3F4 上課教室 Room 生二 220 課程簡述(必填) (最多 500 個中文字) 本欄位資料會上傳教育部課程網 Brief Course Description (required) (50-200 words if possible, up to 1000 letters) This course aims to equip students with foundational programming skills, covering essential programming concepts, logical reasoning, problem-solving strategies, and the syntax and practical applications of programming languages. Emphasizing hands-on practice, the course offers diverse and progressively challenging exercises and projects to help students understand software development processes and master programming techniques. Topics include but are not limited to data types, operators, control flow, functions, arrays, string processing, pointers and memory management, introductory data structures, and file handling. Upon completion of this course, students will be capable of writing clear, efficient, and maintainable code, establishing a solid programming mindset for advanced studies and professional endeavors. 課程內容「中文暨英文關鍵字」(必填) 至少 5 個,每個關鍵字至多 20 個中文,以半形逗點分隔 Please fill in at least 5 course keywords (up to 40 letters for each keyword) and use commas to separate them.(required) Programming Fundamentals Logical Reasoning Problem-solving Hands-on Practice Code Efficiency 課程大綱(必填)Detailed Course Syllabus ● 課程說明(Course Description) This course introduces students to the Python programming language, emphasizing foundational programming skills, problem-solving techniques, and logical reasoning. Students will gain practical experience through extensive hands-on exercises and projects. Topics include Python syntax, control structures, functions, data structures, file processing, and an introduction to object-oriented programming, and fundamental machine learning techniques. ● 指定用書(Text Books) None ● 參考書籍(References) Mark Lutz, "Learning Python," 5th Edition, O'Reilly Media. objective:
The purpose of this course is to provide engineering-oriented students fundamental
knowledge of materials science and engineering.
Textbook:
W. F. Smith and J. Hashemi, "Foundations of Materials Science and Engineering",
7th Ed., McGraw-Hill, ISBN 978-1-260-09203-5
Grade: Quiz (40%), Midterm (30%), Final (30%)
Outline
1. Introduction to Materials Science and Engineering (W1)
- Materials Science and Materials Engineering
- Classification of materials
2. Atomic structure and chemical bonding (W2-W3)
- Atomic structure & atomic models
- Energy state & atomic spectra
- Chemical bonding
3. Crystal and amorphous structure in materials (W3-W5)
- Classification of crystal structure
- Comparison of FCC, HCP and BCC crystal structures
- Miller Indices for crystallographic planes and directions
- Crystal structure analysis
4. Solidification and crystalline imperfections (W6-W7)
- Solidification of metals : nucleation and growth
- metallic solid solutions
- Crystal defects
- Techniques for microstructure and defect inspection
Midterm (W8)
5. Thermally activated processes and diffusion in solids (W9-W10)
- Atomic diffusion in solids
- Industrial applications of diffusion processes
6. Mechanical properties of metals I (W10-W12)
- Processing of metals and alloys
- Stress and strain
- Mechanical testing: tensile test and hardness testing
- Plastic deformation: single crystal and polycrystal
- Strengthening mechanism
- Recovery and recrystallization
- Superplasticity and nanocrystalline metals
7. Mechanical properties of metals II (W13-W15)
- Fracture of metals
- Fatigue of metals
- Creep and stress rupture
8. Phase diagrams (W15-W16)
- Phase diagram: pure substance and binary alloy
- Gibbs phase rule
- Lever rule
- Invariant reactions
- Intermediate phases and compounds
- Ternary phase diagram
Final Exam (W16)

docs.name: 材料科學與工程一
docs.text:
一、課程說明(Course Description)

The purpose of this course is to provide first-year engineering students
fundamental knowledge of materials science and engineering.

二、指定用書(Text Books)

W. F. Smith and J. Hashemi, "Foundations of Materials Science and Engineering",
6th Ed., McGraw-Hill, ISBN 978-1-260-09203-5

四、教學方式(Teaching Method)

Design-Led & Science-Led Teaching approaches and Active Leanings. This course
will be taught by the Science-Led approach mainly, starting from the smallest
building blocks of materials, i.e. atoms-->crystal structure-->solidification--
>crystal defects-->diffusion-->mechanical properties-->phase diagrams.
In order to include interdisciplinary aspect of engineering, design-lead
teaching approach has also been incorporated in this course; firstly, a few case
studies of various critical components in engineering systems will be introduced
to highlight various properties requirements for materials, then the choice of
materials and processes needed to achieve the state of structure for materials
to obtain these properties are described. Students are encouraged to form study
groups for peer instructions and active learning.

五、教學進度(Syllabus)

1. Introduction to materials Science and engineering:
Types of materials/Recent Advances & Future Trends/Design and Selections

2. Atomic structure and bonding:
Electronic Structures/Primary Bonds/Secondary Bonds

3. Crystal and amorphous structure in materials:
Space Lattice and Unit Cells/Crystal Systems and Bravais Lattice/metallic
Crystals/Miller Indices/FCC&BBC&HCP/Analysis

4. Solidification and crystalline imperfections:
Solidification of metal/Imperfection/Identification of defects

5. Thermally activated processes and diffusion in solids:
Diffusion in solid/Industrial applications/Effect of Temperatures

6. Mechanical properties of metals I:
Stress & Strain/Hardness/Plastic deformation/Strengthening by solid
solution/Recovery and Recrystallization/Superplasticity

7. Mechanical properties of metals II :
Fracture/Fatigue/Creep

8. Phase diagrams :
Pure substance/Gibbs Phase rule/Cooling curves/Binary systems/Ternary systems

六、成績考核(Evaluation)

Grade: Recap & Recitation Classes (10%), Midterm Exam (30%), Final Exam (60%)

*本課程無涉及AI使用。

● Course Description
In the first semester, this course will introduce the three laws of thermodynamics
and various thermodynamic functions such as heat capacity, entropy, enthalpy, and
free energy. We will discuss the thermodynamic properties of single-phase gases
and condensed systems. We will also explain the microscopic meaning of entropy
from the perspective of statistical thermodynamics and the relationship between
the partition function and free energy, providing specific examples to illustrate
its application in the theoretical derivation of heat capacity.

Laboratories of Materials I is to verify the knowledge of Material Science
learned in relevant courses and find out the relationships between the
processes, properties, and microstructure of materials through practices.
The experiments contain instrument practices of analysis and identification
of materials, sample preparation and observation of microstructures, tests

treatment of steel.

一、課程說明：

docs.text:
一、課程說明(Course Description)
材料分析為各領域材料中進行研究，掌握確切證據與釐清現象的重要工具。本課程主要建構於繞射
學、顯微術以及光譜學三大基礎，旨在闡釋固態材料內部與表面的晶體結構、顯微結構以及成分、
鍵結等之分析技術。本課程將逐步剖析X光繞射儀、穿透式電子顯微鏡、光學及電子顯微鏡、歐傑
電子能譜儀、化學分析電子光譜儀、二次離子質譜儀，以及各式光譜儀等，了解不同技術所對應的
分析原理與分析尺度。在課程中都將有實例介紹，並解釋如何分析數據，課程中也將安排分組
報告，使學生得以了解並深入各種常見的材料分析應用。此課程適合大三以上或欲進行專題實作學生，
本學期採英語授課。
Materials Analysis is constructed by Microscopy, Diffraction, and Chemistry
Analysis, which focuses on the inside and surface of solid materials on
morphology, structure, and composition characterization. In this semester, the
course contains those techniques such as Scanning electron microscopy (SEM),
Transmission electron microscopy (TEM), X-ray Diffraction (XRD), X-ray
microanalysis (EDS/WDS), Scanning probe microscopy (SPM), Auger electron
spectroscopy (AES), X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS/ESCA), and Secondary
ion mass spectroscopy (SIMS). Develops analytical skills to strengthen research
ability for independent studies with an integrated approach that combines
techniques, principals and implementation perspectives.The course is offered in
English.

二、指定用書(Text Books)

microanalysis. Springer.

docs.text:
課程說明 (Course Description)
本課程旨在介紹固態物理的核心概念，並說明其在各類電子元件中的實際應用，涵蓋能帶結構、載子傳輸及半
導體元件的基本運作原理，讓學生能理解電子元件設計與應用背後的物理基礎。
This course introduces the core concepts of solid state physics and explains
their practical applications in various electronic devices. Topics include energy
band structures, carrier transport, and the fundamental operating principles of
semiconductor devices, enabling students to understand the physical foundations
behind electronic device design and applications.

指定用書 (Text Book)
Donald A. Neamen, Semiconductor Physics and Devices
參考書籍 (References)
Donald A. Neamen, Semiconductor Physics and Devices
S. M. Sze & Kwok K. Ng, Physics of Semiconductor Devices

教學方式 (Teaching Methods)
講授 (Lectures)，習題演練 (Problem-solving sessions)，課堂討論 (Class discussion)

教學進度 (Course Schedule)
Week 1: Introduction & Crystal Structure of Solids (lattices, Miller indices,
bonding)
Week 2: Quantum Mechanics Basics for Solids (wave–particle duality, Schrödinger
equation)
Week 3: Energy Bands (Bloch theorem, band formation, density of states, effective
mass)
Week 4: Semiconductor in Equilibrium (intrinsic and doped semiconductors, Fermi
level, statistical distributions)
Week 5: Carrier Transport (drift, diffusion, mobility, scattering mechanisms)
Week 6: Nonequilibrium Carriers (carrier lifetime, recombination, generation)
Week 7: pn Junctions I (equilibrium junction, built-in potential, depletion
region)
Week 8: pn Junctions II (forward and reverse bias, I–V characteristics,
capacitance effects)
Week 9: metal–Semiconductor Junctions (Schottky barrier, ohmic contacts)
Week 10: MOS Capacitors (energy band diagrams, C–V characteristics)
Week 11: Bipolar Junction Transistor (structure, operation principles, current
gain)
Week 12: Field-Effect Transistors (junction FETs, MOSFETs)
Week 13: Optoelectronic & Advanced Devices (LEDs, solar cells, photodetectors,
emerging devices)

docs.name: 固態熱力學
docs.text:
一、課程說明(Course Description)

This is an advanced course of thermodynamics for graduate students in the
Department of Materials Science and Engineering. Students from other
disciplines in science and engineering are also welcome to take. The course
will start from review of the three laws of thermodynamics and then move to
more insight of entropy and free energies. The calculation and application
of Gibbs free energy in solid solutions and alloy systems will be
emphasized, which will then be correlated with the construction of phase
diagrams. The thermodynamics involved in surface energy and nanomaterials will
be elaborated. Students will be asked to participate in classroom discussion.
Teaching materials also come from the OCW or MOOCs on the web. The lecture will
be given in English.

二、指定用書(Text Books)
1. "Thermodynamics of Solids," 2nd ed., 1972, Richard A. Swalin, John Wiley
& Sons, Inc.
2. “Introduction to the Thermodynamics of Materials,” 6th ed., 2018, David
R. Gaskell and David E. Laughlin, Taylor & Francis.

三、參考書籍(References)

1. Robert DeHoff, "Thermodynamics in Materials Science," 2nd ed.,
Taylor & Francis, 2006.
2. Ira N. Levine, "Physical Chemistry", 6 ed., McGraw-Hill, 2009.

四、教學方式(Teaching Method)

1. Lecture in English
2. Videos of previous lectures
3. MOOCs course "Thermodynamics of Solids" on NTHU MOOCs

五、教學進度(Syllabus)

1. Introduction
2. The First Law of Thermodynamics
3. The Second and Third Laws of Thermodynamic
4. Relations among Thermodynamic Quantities
5. Thermodynamics of Phase Transformations
6. Thermodynamics of Solid Solutions
7. Free Energy of Binary Systems
8. Phase Diagrams
9. Thermodynamics of Surfaces
10. Thermodynamics of Nanomaterials

六、成績考核(Evaluation)

1. Quiz 5% x 4
2. Midterm 25% x 2
2. Final Exam 30%

七、可連結之網頁位址

The links to the videos of previous lectures in the class and MOOCs will be
announced to the students.

八、AI使用規則 (Use of AI in the class)

Students must specify how generative AI is used in course output.

docs.text:
一、課程說明(Course Description)

本課程之目標，在於建立學生對於鋼鐵與其他合金製程與應用之的基本認知，課程內容主要介紹
於使用最為廣泛之現代化鋼鐵材料之生產、製造、加工、設計、分析、整合、規劃及其應用實
例；另一部分為合金之生產、製造、加工、設計及其應用實例。在材料應用環境日漸嚴峻與節能
減碳的趨勢之下，本校與中鋼公司已經成立先進特殊合金工程研發中心，對金屬合金材料研究開
發而努力，藉由本課程的介紹與解說，瞭解在各個產業的挑戰與未來發展，發掘更多應用機會。
內容包含:
鋼鐵(2/3課程):1. 軋延冶金技術概論 2. 鋼鐵產品組織控制技術與原理3. 鋼鐵產品種類與應
用─碳鋼產品 4. 鋼鐵產品種類與應用─不鏽鋼產品 5. 鋼鐵產品之二次加工技術 6. 鋼鐵產品
之防蝕技術 7. 軋延製程技術概論 8. 鋼材之加熱與冷卻 9. 煤炭及煉焦製程 10. 鐵礦及燒
結製程 11. 煉鐵製程 12. 轉爐煉鋼製程 13. 連鑄製程 14. 鋼鐵冶金之節能減碳15. 工廠
參觀 特殊合金(1/3課程): 1.高溫超合金, 2.鈦與鈦合金, 3.靶材應用開發,

由中鋼專業工程師授課，上課使用投影片，可讓同學深入學習當今重要工程材料之完整生產製
程，以及過程中所涉及之冶金及材料技術，並瞭解學校所學的理論課程與實務應用之關聯。

docs.name: 天然高分子材料
docs.text:
一、課程說明(Course Description)
本課程將由淺入深，介紹地球上豐富的天然高分子，包括目前的各主流種類: 纖維素、幾丁質、澱
粉、豆蛋白、酪蛋白、藻膠、木質素、半纖維素、細菌性纖維素、聚乳酸、和PHA塑膠(聚羥基脂肪
酸酯)，希望藉著這個課程，讓同學認識充斥在我們周遭環境，但卻又陌生的天然高分子材料，讓學生

docs.text: Introduction to Metamaterials and Plasmonics (超材料與電漿子學) Welcome to the course of Introduction to Metamaterials and Plasmonics (超材料與電 漿 子 學 ). This course focuses on two cutting-edge techniques, metamaterials and plasmonics, and is given by English. Metamaterials are artificially constructed materials, whose properties mainly stem from their sub-wavelength geometric designs, rather than their constitutive elements. Plasmonics is based on plasmonic resonances, which refer to the collective oscillation of free electrons and electromagnetic excitation. Since the past two decades, both metamaterials and plasmonics have been attracting increasingly attention because they enable rare and even unprecedented properties. First, I will introduce a variety of metamaterials, including split-ring resonators, plasmonic wires, negative index media, fishnet structures, two-hand metamaterials, hyperbolic metamaterials, metasurfaces, perfect absorbers and son on. Second, I will present localized surface plasmon resonance, surface plasmon polaritons and their applications. Third, I will show two tools of numerical simulation, FDTD and FEM. Finally, I will teach you effective communication, including oral presentation and technical writing, to help you tackle your term projects. The last but not the least, this course is “conditionally open to using AI. Please specify how generative AI will be used in course output.

This course focuses on progress and challenges of energy technology from a
materials science approach. It begins with introduction to renewable and
sustainable energy and moves forward to discuss the principles of several energy
devices, including energy storage, energy transformation, and energy harvesting
devices. It then describes the roles of materials science on the performance of
those devices. The course will include a group project where students make use of
their learning in class and their creativity to propose an original idea to
improve some aspects of energy technologies. This course focus more on
electrochemical devices while other types of energy technology will also be
included.

The purpose of this course is designed to familiarize the student with the
operation of SEM and FESEM.
Focuses are directed to study the effects of instrument operational
parameters on image characteristics, and then

docs.text: 專題研究課程大綱 NEMS100000 授課教師 : 由本所指派之教師擔任課程代表教師。由本所教師或合聘教師擔任 指導學生專題研究之責。 課程程度: 大學部ㄧ年級至四年級 課程目標: 藉由本所教師之專業與研究室既有之資源，提供學生實際參與執行 奈微米科技相關之研究工作，以增進學生對基礎理論之運用，同時培養學生以 解決問題為導向的學習方法，藉以強化學生的分析技巧，組織能力，邏輯思 考，深入探索，執行能力，以及決斷力。為學生提供探索興趣與發現專長的機 會。 進行方式：由指導教授根據研究室專長與資源，考量學生背景與程度，為學生 規劃適切之研究主題，內容，與目標。其課程設計應以ㄧ學期內能執行完畢為 原則，相關研究設施之教育訓練應足夠。學生於學期末應繳交研究自評表，以 及研究報告兩份文件予指導教授，由指導教授進行評分，再呈報給課程代表教 師。 時間：學期中進行，不限定固定時段。 成績計算: 由指導教授根據學生之研究自評表與研究報告書，進行總評分。 授課老師與研究主題： 王玉麟教授：電晶體感測器，化學感測器，生醫感測器，半導體元件，半導體 製程，3D IC 封裝技術。能量收集與熱管理。大數據分析，人工智慧於生物與 醫學應用（具程式設計能力者佳）。 黃至正教授：自旋電子元件，磁性生醫感測器，生醫電子，類比前端電路與系 統，積體電路設計，單細胞微流體晶片，液態活檢，外泌體，奈米磁學，奈米 醫藥，腫瘤微環境，鐵凋亡，磁生物學。 Special Research Course Outline Instructor: The course representative professor will be appointed by iNEMS. The iNEMS faculties or affiliated professors will be responsible for guiding students in their special research projects. Course Level: undergraduate students, from freshman to senior students. Course Objectives: Utilizing the expertise of the institute's teachers and the existing resources of the laboratories, this course aims to provide students with practical participation in research related to nanotechnology. The goal is to enhance students' application of fundamental theories while fostering a problem-solving oriented learning approach. This will strengthen students' analytical skills, organizational abilities, logical thinking, in-depth exploration, execution capabilities, and decision-making skills. The course also offers students opportunities to explore their interests and discover their specialties. Method of Implementation: The advisors need to plan appropriate research topics, content, and objectives for the students based on the laboratory's expertise and resources, considering the students' backgrounds and capability. The course should be designed so that it can be completed within one semester. Adequate training on relevant research facilities should be provided. At the end of the semester, students are required to submit a self-evaluation form and a research report to their advisors, who will then grade them and report the grades to the course representative professor. Time: Courses conducted during the semester, with no fixed schedule. Grading: Advisors will decide the final grades based on the students' self-evaluation forms and their research reports. docs.text: 國立清華大學課程大綱【格式】 <1050112 版 > 科號 NEMS 4000 44000 組別 學分 2 人數限制 190 上課時間 W7 (15:30-16:20) W8 (16:30-17:20) 教室 綜合四館 121 教室 （校門進來左手 邊全家便利商店同棟） 科目中文名稱 奈微米科技驅動世界運轉 科目英文名稱 Micro-Nano Technology Drives the World 任課教師 王玉麟 (主課)、李昇憲、方維倫、曾繁根, 馮國華、傅建中, 陳致真、許 佳賢、賴梅鳳、劉承賢、林宗宏、森川響二朗, 董國忠, 擋修科目 擋修分數 請勾選 此科目對應之系所課程規畫所欲培養之核心能力 Core capability to be cultivated by this course 權重（百分比） Percentage Ｖ 自我瞭解與溝通表達 Self-awareness, expressions & communication 10% V 邏輯推理與批判思考能力 Logical reasoning & critical thinking 20% V 科學思維與反思 Scientific thinking & reflection 50% 藝術與人文涵養 Aesthetic & humanistic literacy % 資訊科技與媒體素養 Information technology & media literacy % V 多元觀點與社會實踐 Diverse views & social practices 20% 一、課程說明 1.課程宗旨、目標： 在奈微米微小尺度下，先進的科技與工藝創造出最新的微小元件與系 統，這些元件與系統廣泛使用在電子，通訊，醫療，消費，娛樂，軍事， 生物，環境，食品，太空等方面，乃至影響經濟與文化領域，並且仍在 快速的不斷演進當中，瞭解這些微小尺度下的元件與系統，以及其應用 的方式，對於解決人類社會的重要問題能夠提供從科技的角度所產生的 創新性想法。 2.課程能帶給學生什麼知識、能力： 對微小元件與系統基本的認識，包含原理，概念，及其應用。藉由瞭解 當代尖端科技，提供創造性思維，激發以科技解決人類問題的想像力。 二、指定用書 教師提供講義 三、參考書籍 教師提供講義 四、教學方式 專題講述 五、教學進度 Wk1 (9/4): 課程簡介：王玉麟教授。微觀流體的奇異世界-微奈米生醫晶 片的奇幻旅程：曾繁根特聘教授 主旨：介紹微流體系統的微觀物理現象以及其奇妙的生醫應用 學生可習得的內容：（1）微觀流體的物理現象：昆蟲飛行,細菌游泳, 以 及荷葉表面的出淤泥不染 (2)生醫晶片的應用：微流體生醫晶片在快速血 液檢測, 大量藥物篩檢, 以及動物實驗減量上的奇妙應用與貢獻 參考書目：1.課程講義 2.Patrick Tabeling, Introduction to Microfluidics Oxford University Press; Reprint edition (September 1, 2010) Wk2 (9/11): 小小世界真美妙-微機電系統簡介課程介紹：方維倫講座教授 主旨：無論學生是否具有工程背景，或半導體相關技術，皆能透過本課 程的安排，了解晶圓上小小世界的奧秘。 學生可習得內容：讓學生了解，何謂微系統，以及其可能的應用，並說 明如何利用半導體的技術，實現微系統。 參考書目：課堂講義 Wk3 (9/18): 微型振動世界觀–奇妙的微機械放大器: 李昇憲教授講座教 授 主旨：簡述微機械共振器的原理、特性、與其應用面。 學生可習得內容：(1)什麼是自然共振頻率、共振模態、共振器或機械放 大器?(2)共振式傳感器基本結構與工作原理。(3) 共振式傳感器在時域與 頻域的獨到之處與優勢。(4) 共振式傳感器如何改變未來通訊與感測市 場。 參考書目：1. 課堂講義 2. Stephen D. Senturia, Microsystem Design, Kluwer Academic Publishers, 2000. Wk4 (9/25): 微型半導體感測器重塑未來醫療: 王玉麟教授 主旨：簡述半導體感測器的原理，特質，與應用。 學生可習得內容：(1)什麼是半導體(2)半導體感測器基本結構(3)半導體感 測器的獨特之處(4)半導體感測器如何改變未來醫療行為 參考書目：1.課堂講義 2.“Semiconductor Devices-Based Sensors for Gas, Chemical, and Biomedical Applications” by Fan Ren & Stephen J. Pearton, CRC Press, 2011 (ISBN: 978-1-4398-1387-4) Wk5 (10/2): 微小驅動的大應用: 馮國華教授 主旨：簡述壓電和離子聚合金屬複合智能材料所製作的傳感器於微致動 領域所扮演的重要應用。 學生可習得的內容：(1) 壓電（鐵電）材料的工作原理。(2) 離子聚合金 屬複合材料的工作原理。(3)如何以微製程製作壓電、離子聚合金屬複合 材料的傳感器。(4)壓電、離子聚合金屬複合材料傳感器的現有和未來可 能的重要應用。 參考書目：1.課堂講義 2. Cain, Markys G., ed. Characterisation of ferroelectric bulk materials and thin films. Vol. 2. Dordrecht: Springer Netherlands, 2014. 3. Shahinpoor, Mohsen, ed. Ionic Polymer Metal Composites (IPMCs): Smart Multi-Functional Materials and Artificial Muscles, Volume 2. Royal Society of Chemistry, 2015. Wk6 (10/9): 奇妙的磁性奈微米元件：賴梅鳳教授 主旨: 簡述磁性奈微米元件的原理、特性、與相關應用 學生可習得內容：(1)磁學概述(2)磁在生活中的應用(3)磁性材料的種類與 特性(4)自旋電子學時代的來臨:磁性奈微米元件介紹 參考書目：1. 課堂講義 2."Magnetic Actuators and Sensors" by John R. Brauer, Wiley-IEEE Press, 2nd Edition, 2014 (ISBN: 978-1-118-50525-0) Wk7 (10/16): 小小奈米材料在感測應用的大大優勢: 林宗宏教授 主旨：本課程將會從科學及工程的角度來教授學生有關奈米材料的光學 特性。內容將涵蓋功能性奈米材料的主要類別，以及對當前生物分析技 術和奈米科技的實際回顧，特別是在感測和影像上的應用。 學生可習得內容：學生透過此課程的學習，將會了解奈米材料特有的光 學性質及目前發展中的應用，使學生具備充分的背景知識，應用在相關 技術及產品的研發上。 參考書目： 1. “Optical Properties and Spectroscopy of Nanomaterials”by Jin Z. Zhang, World Scientific, 2009 (ISBN: 978-981-283-664-9) 2. “From Bioimaging to Biosensors: Noble Metal Nanoparticles in Biodetection”, by Chau Lai-Kwan, Huan-Tsung Chang, 2012, 1st Ed. Jenny Stanford Publishin (ISBN 9789814267243) WK8: 期中考(10/23) WK9 (10/30): 歐洲的微系統技術與德國的工程教育思維: 傅建中教授 主旨: 介紹德國微系統技術發展的緣由, 歷程, 並介紹德國的工程教育 制度。 參考書目: 1. 課堂講義。2. Microsystem Technology, W. Menz, J. Mohr, O. Paul, Wiley-VC 3. LIGA and it Applications, Brand etc., Wiley-VCH WK10 (11/6): 全校運動會（停課ㄧ天） WK11 (11/13): 機電控制遇見生醫-精準醫學替身醫療器官晶片：劉承賢 教授 主旨：提供同學認識微小化科技，應用在工程與生醫跨領域的結合應用， 以精準醫學替身醫療器官晶片角度出發，介紹工程技術、器官晶片的舉 例介紹、應用的市場、需求及價值。 參考書目：課堂講義。 WK12 (11/20): 生物的奈微米元件: 陳致真教授 主旨：簡述生物體內製造的奈微米元件、特性、功能與研究工具。 學生可習得內容：(1)奈微米技術之生物及醫療上的應用、(2)研究生物系 統所需要的不同考量 參考書目：課堂講義 WK13 (11/27): 模仿動物體內環境之生物微晶片: 許佳賢研究員 主旨: 介紹微流體晶片如何在生物體外創造出可模擬動物體內生理環境 以及相關應用 學生可習得內容：1.體外生理模型, 2.微流體晶片在建立體外生理模型之 應用 3.未來之趨勢 參考書目：課堂講義 WK14 (12/4): 微流體-奈米尺度化學以及微流體裝置 (Nanofluidics - Nanoscale chemistry and Nanofluidic devices) Prof. Kyojiro Morikawa (英語 授課, Offered in English) 主旨：Brief introduction for nanofluidic device engineering and nanoscale liquid chemistry. Especially for nanofluidic device fabrication, fluid control method, liquid property, application to analytical methods. 學生可習得內容：(1)Research tools in nanofluidics, (2)General technology in nanofluidics, (3)Unique liquid properties in nanospaces 參考書目：課堂講義 WK15 (12/11): 奈米讓光與電在ㄧ起：董國忠副研究員 WK16 (12/18): 期末考 + 實體元件觀摩與解說: 王玉麟教授 主旨: 使同學可以直接觀察各種奈微米元件與其運作方始 學生可習得內容：藉由實際接觸與觀察各種奈微米元件，強化與課堂教 學的理論連結，增進更深刻的理解與認識 六、成績考核 期中考：50%, 期末考：50%. 以是非題或選擇題方式出題。 七、講義位址 http://

docs.name: 射頻微機電元件及應用
docs.text: Course No.: 110NEMS5800 RF MEMS Components and Applications Fall 2025 Instructor: Guo-Hua Feng Office: Rm. 508, Engineering Bldg. I, TEL: (03)5715131 ext.33603 Email address: ghfeng@pme.nthu.edu.tw Office Hours: TBD Classroom and time: Rm. 212, Engineering Bldg. I, Thursday 2:20-5:20 pm Teaching Assistant: TBD Course Description: Radio Frequency Micro Electro Mechanical Systems (RF MEMS) are miniaturized devices that are created using micromachining technologies similar to those used to manufacture integrated circuits, and are capable of performing many tasks and functions, such as frequency selection, frequency generation, and frequency translation, that involve mechanical, electrical, and other types of signals. RF MEMS and related Integrated Microsystems are increasingly finding applications in many areas, especially in signal processing and telecommunications. RF MEMS industry is also ready to penetrate into wireless communication products (filters, timing reference devices, switches, etc.). This is an introductory and design course of RF MEMS components with class lectures and hands-on design labs based on ANSYS/Comsol Multiphysics/CoventorWare. This course introduces students to this rapidly emerging multi-disciplinary and exciting field. It will teach fundamentals of micromachining and microfabrication techniques that are crucial to RF MEMS fabrication. A designer of RF MEMS requires knowledge and expertise across several different disciplines. Therefore, this course will pay attention to teaching fundamentals necessary for the design and analysis of RF MEMS devices and systems in mechanical and electrical domains, and will teach basic techniques for multi-domain analysis (e.g., electromechanical). Fundamentals of transduction mechanism (i.e., conversion between mechanical signals and electrical signals), including capacitive and piezoelectric techniques, and design and analysis of micromachined miniature devices using these techniques will be covered. Many examples of exciting devices and their applications will be reviewed. Students with electronic background and non-electronics are all welcome to study such interdisciplinary subject. Successful project designs will have opportunities to be made via foundry MEMS process. Tentative Outline: Week Lecture Date Lecture 1 9/4 Introduction to RF MEMS Technologies 2 9/11 Applications in Wireless Communications 3 9/18 Microfabrication Technologies 4 9/25 Structure Analysis 5 10/2 Resonant Transducers 6 10/10 Vibration Theory and Resonator Modeling 7 10/16 Capacitive Transduction 8 10/23 Micromechanical Resonator 9 11/6 Midterm Project Presentation 10 11/13 Midterm Exam 11 11/13 Micromechanical Oscillator/Filter 12 11/20 CMOS-MEMS Technologies 13 11/27 SAW and FBAR 14 12/4 Final Project Presentation I 15 12/11 Final Project Presentation II Textbook: Class Notes. References – Books: 1) Stephen D. Senturia, Microsystem Design, Kluwer Academic Publishers, 2000 2) Gregory T. A. Kovacs, Micromachined Transducers Sourcebook, McGraw Hill, 1998 3) R. S. Muller, R. T. Howe, S. D. Senturia, R. L. Smith, and R. M. White, Microsensors, New York: IEEE Press, 1991 4) M. Madou, Fundamental of Microfabrication, New York: CRC Press, 1997 5) M. Elwenspoek, H. Jansen, Silicon Micromachining, Kluwer Academic Publishers, 2001 6) J. W. Gardner, “Microsensors – Principles and Applications,” John Wiley & Sons, 1994 References – Journals: IEEE/ASME Journal of Microelectromechanical Systems (JMEMS) IEEE Transactions on Ultrasonics, Ferroelectrics, and Frequency Control (JUFFC) IOP Journal of Micromechanics and Microengineering (JM&M) Sensors and Actuators Sensors and Materials IEEE Sensors IEEE Transactions on Electron Devices References – Conference Proceedings: IEEE Micro Electro Mechanical Systems Workshop (MEMS’XX, every year) International Conference on Solid-State Sensors and Actuators (Transducers’XX, odd years) Solid-State Sensor and Actuator Workshop (Hilton Head Island, even years) IEEE International Electron Devices Meeting (IEDM’XX, every year) IEEE International Solid-State Circuits Conference (ISSCC’XX, every year) IEEE Ultrasonics Symposium (Ultrasonics’XX, every year) IEEE Frequency Control Symposium (IFCS’XX, every year) Prerequisite: This course is intended for undergraduate seniors and graduate students. It is a half- introductory-and-half-advanced course designed for those students who are not familiar with RF MEMS, microfabrication technologies, integrated circuits, or non-electrical devices and systems. Therefore, the course prerequisites are selected to allow students from MANY engineering and science disciplines, including mechanical, electrical, chemical, aerospace, biomedical, and material engineering to take the course. The course is organized into lectures and computation labs. The lectures present material that ALL students need to learn and the labs are intended to teach students how to use simulators to facilitate the RF MEMS design procedure. The following academic background is required for this course: (a) college math, calculus, and differential equations; (b) basic college-level physics and chemistry. Grading Policy: (subject to revision) Homework 20%, Midterm Exam 30%, Final Project 40%, Class Participation 10% * This course does not involve the use of AI.

docs.text: Lecture Outline 課程大綱 (Minor reasonable changes may apply without prior notice. 有可能出現不事先通知的小幅度且合理的變更。) Last updated: May 29, 2025 Flexible Electronics and Systems 軟性電子元件與系統 (NEMS5820) Cheng-Yao Lo 羅丞曜 Lectures are given in English. 英文授課。 Schedule 時間 W2W3W4 每週三 2, 3, 4 堂 Place 地點 Delta321 台達館 321 教室 TA 助教 TBA Prerequisite 修課條件 Students are expected to have a bachelor’s degree in physics-, chemistry-, mechanics- or electrical-related engineering fields. 建議修課學生應具有大學部工程背景。 Description 課程目標 Flexible electronics device and system made by printing technologies gained various attentions from the professional fields of physics, chemistry, material, and electrical engineering, which generated a novel research field of flexible printronics. This lecture is a part of and the fundamental of “Flexible Electronics”. This lecture contains the design, simulation, process, and testing based on a flexible display device. Students will gain combinational knowledge of solid-state and polymer electronics device and system as well as their respective processes. Practical simulations will be introduced to let students obtain real feelings of the optical designs. docs.text: Electron Theory in Solids (固態電子理論) Course level: Graduate students Course goals: Understanding the fundamental theory of electron in solids, including metal and semiconductors, as well as the electronic properties in bulk and low dimensional scales. Knowledge taught in this course is an important base of the fundamental knowledge of semiconductors materials. Lab practicing and selected topic presentation are designed to enhance the efficacy of student’s learning. This course is a prerequisite course for students who will learn semiconductor device physics. Keywords: Scattering model, Wave mechanics, Quantum mechanics, Density of States, Distribution function, Bloch Theorem, carrier concentration, Hall effects, Excess carries, Semiconductor materials, PN junction, Ohmic Contacts. Text Book : “Solid State Physics for Engineering & Materials Science,” by John McKelvey, Krieger Publishing, ISBN 0-89464-436-X “Principles of Electronic Materials and Devices,” by S. O. Kasop, McGraw Publishing, 3rd edition, ISBN 007-124458-1 Handouts will be provided Course Outline 1. Classical Free electron in metals (9/4) 2. Classical Physics: Wave properties and behaviors/History of Quantum Mechanics (9/11) 3. Quantum Mechanics: Wave Mechanics/Uncertainty principles/1D infinite/finite potential wells (9/18) 4. Quantum Mechanics: Tunneling of particles/Density of states (9/25) 5. Statistical Mechanics: Distribution function (10/2) 6. Designated topic presentation 1 (10/9) (Simply use the lecture materials provided by the instructor. Additional preparation of the presentation slide is not needed.) 7. Exam 1 (10/16) 8. Review and discussion (10/23) 9. Quantum Mechanics for crystals: Bloch Theorem/Semiconductor properties: Carrier concentration and conductivity (10/30) 10. Semiconductor Materials Properties: Hall Effects and excess carriers (11/06) 11. PN junction (11/13, 11/20) 12. Lab practice: Electrical Measurement: Ohmic contacts/sheet resistance (11/27) 13. Designated topic presentation 2 (12/04) (Simply use the lecture materials provided by the instructor. Additional preparation of the presentation slide is not needed. 14. Exam 2 (12/11) 15. Final Presentation (12/18) Research Topics must be selected as “Novel 2D-semiconductor materials” published in Nature/Science series journals. Grading: Exam 1- 25%, Exam 2- 25%, Designated topic presentation 10%, Final presentation 25%, Lab practicing with reports 10%, attendance & contribution to the class 5%. 1. For the Exam 1and Exam 2: Closed book exams. 2. For the designated topic presentation: students will present a designated topic as in the lecture materials and will be asked questions by the instructor and the class. 3. For the Lab practicing: Electrical measurements with written reports including the principle, measurement setup and steps, results and discussion, and conclusion. 4. English is required for the presentation. Language fluency may be considered in grading. Students need to present one major paper and include a few references in the presentation. Research topics should be the “Novel 2D semiconductor materials” published in Nature/Science series journals”. Students are required to present the topic by utilizing the knowledge they have learned in this class. The significance, organization, depth/scientific sound, speaking fluency, and Q&A will be evaluated for the presentation. 5. docs.text: NEMS5860 Optical Transducers Institute of Nanotechnology and Microsystems Instructor: Wei-Chih Wang, Ph.D. Office: Delta 319 Grading: 3 credits Class Time: Lecture Monday 1:20-3:20 PM Lab TBA Course website: http://courses.washington.edu/me557/sensor Objectives The objective of this course is to provide the students with a broad understanding of the fundamental science, basic operation, technology choice, and practical aspects of optical transducers in sensor application. The emphasis for application of the devices discussed will be in optical sensors however the information from this course is important to other photonic technology areas such as fiber optic communication systems, optical interconnects, and optical signal processing. Additional periodic and electro-optic devices and their applications will also be covered. On completing this course students will: • understand the fundamentals of a variety of optical devices used for measurements of physical, chemical, biological parameters. • understand the commonly used optical techniques and materials for sensor applications. • be able to solve basic analytical problems associated with physical principles of optical sensors • be able to apply the acquired knowledge to propose solutions to a given physical problems. The course involves lectures, design homework, laboratory work and a final project. The theoretical background and technique for testing will be extensively discussed. The lab work involves several major projects as well as various testing demonstrations. Most of the projects involve analysis, instrumentation, and theoretical predictions, as well as written reports. The final design project will require both theoretical and actual hardware design as well as an oral and written presentation. Topics Review of Geometric Optics and Electromagnetic wave Theory Waveguide Theory Introduction to fiber optic and waveguide delivery and detection Introduction to light sources and photodetectors Multilayer structure sensors: waveguide, filters, resonator Periodic structure sensors Spectroscopic and microscopic sensors Audience This course is for persons who wish to learn various optical technique using integrated photonic device, waveguide and optical fibers for sensing technology and review their implementation and applications for industrial and biomedical uses. This course is also appeal to students with diverse technical backgrounds, thereby encouraging interdisciplinary discussions. "Experimental evidence is the truth theory must mimic." •Textbooks: - Applied Electromagnetism, Liang Chi Shen, Weber&Schmidt Dubury - Fundamentals of Photonics, B. Saleh, John Wiley& Sons. - Guide-wave Optoeletronics, T. Tamir, ed., Springer Verlag - Optoelectronics and Photonics: Principles and Practices, S. O. Kasap, Prentice Hall. - Integrated Optics: Theory and Technology, R. G. Hunsperger, Springer-Verlag - Optical Fiber Communications, J. Senior, Prentice- Hall - Fiber optic Sensors, E. Udd, John Wiley& Sons - Selected papers in optical sensors, optical MEMS devices and integrated Optical devices. •Grading: Homework and lab assignments 80% (4 problem solving assignments, 3 labs and 1 design project) Final Project 20% Final Project: - Choose topics related to fiberopic sensors, waveguide sensors or integrated optics devices and optical MEMS system. - Details of the project will be announced in midquarter - Two people can work as a team on a project, but each person needs to turn in his/her own final report. - Oral presentation will be held in the end of the quarter on your final project along with your final report. Course Prerequisite(s)  First year physics in Optics or permission of instructor.  A creative mind and willingness to get one’s hands dirty in construction  Come to class with an open mind and a willingness to participate fully! Course Outline: GOALS: To develop student understanding of Week 1-2 Ray-Optics Theory (Snell's law, Geometric optics, thin lens, matrix method) Week 3-4 Electromagnetic-Wave Approach (wave equation, polarization, diffraction, interference, grating) Week 5-6 Electromagnetic-Wave Approach (wave equation, polarization, diffraction, interference, diffraction grating, waveplate, Jones matrix) Week 7 Theory of Waveguides : Ray-Optics Approach Week 8 Theory of Waveguides : Electromagnetic-Wave Approach Week 9 Theory of Waveguides : Modes in Rectangular Waveguides, Losses in Waveguides Week 10 Theory of waveguides : Waveguide coupling Week 11 Optical sources and detectors Week 12 Fiberoptic and polymer waveguide sensors (Intensity, phase modulation and polarization) Week 13 Periodic structure sensors (Grating, photonic crystal, metamaterial) Week 14 Biosensor, bio-optics and biomedical Applications (micro display, microscopy and spectroscopy sensors) Week 15 Fabrication of integrated optical MEMS and Waveguide Integrated Optics Week 16 Polymer for photonic application Week 17 Electro and magneto active polymer for photonic application Week 18 Final project presentation

docs.name: 輻射劑量學
docs.text:
一、課程說明(Course Description)
The primary objective of this course is to impart students with a
foundational
grasp of radiation dosimetry, while also establishing a robust base for
researchers intrigued by domains like medical physics, health physics, nuclear
energy, or environmental monitoring. The course delves extensively into
elucidating radiation dose definitions, detailing radiation-material
interactions, and explicating the correlation between radiation effects and
radiation dose. This comprehensive course is meticulously crafted to furnish
participants with an extensive comprehension of radiation dosimetry's
principles, methodologies, and real-world applications. Irrespective of whether
you're an aspiring physicist, a healthcare professional, an engineer, or simply
driven by curiosity, this course will furnish you with the indispensable
knowledge and skills to effectively and safely assess, measure, and manage
radiation exposure.

本課程的主要目標是為學生建立放射劑量測的基礎知識，同時為對醫學物理學、健康物理學、核能或環境監測
等領域感興趣的研究人員奠定堅實基礎。本課程深入探討輻射劑量定義，詳細介紹放射線與物質作用，並闡明
輻射效應與劑量之間的關聯。這門綜合性課程經過精心設計，旨在為參與者提供廣泛的放射劑量測原則、方法
論和實際應用的理解。這門課適合以下學生：志在成為醫學物理學家、醫療專業人員、工程師，還是純粹出於
好奇心，本課程將提供必要的知識和技能，以有效安全的方式評估、測量和管理輻射曝露。

二、指定用書(Textbook)
1. F. H. Attix, Introduction to Radiological Physics and Radiation Dosimetry,
John Wiley & Sons, Inc., 1986.
2. James E. Turner, "Atoms, Radiation and Radiation Protection," 3rd Edition,
Wiley-VCH, Weinheim, 2007.

三、參考書籍(References)
1. Glenn F. Knoll, Radiation Detection and Measurement, Wiley, 2010.

四、教學方式(Teaching Method)
1. 授課(Lectures)
2. 討論(Discussion)
3. 專題與簡報(Project & Presentation)

五、教學進度(Syllabus)
Part I. Introduction
1. Ionizing radiation (Attix Ch.1)
2. Review of Probability Distribution Function and Error Propagation
3. Radioactive decay (Attix Ch.6)
4. Exponential attenuation (Attix Ch.3)

Part II. Basic Quantities for Dosimetry
1. Quantities for describing the interaction of ionizing radiation with matter
(Attix Ch.2)
2. Charged-particle and radiation equilibrium (Attix Ch.4)
3. Absorbed dose in radioactive media (Attix Ch.5)

Part III. Radiation Interaction with Matter
1. Charged-particle interactions in matter (Attix Ch.8)
2. Gamma- and X-ray interactions in matter (Attix Ch.7)
3. Neutron interactions in matter (Attix Ch.16)

Part IV. Cavity Theory and Dosimeter Fundamentals
1. Cavity theory (Attix Ch.10)
2. Dosimeter fundamentals (Attix Ch.11)

Part V. Internal dosimetry
1. Radiopharmacology. Dr. Chih-Hsien Chang, 2024/11/20.
2. Dosimetry - Absorbed Dose Evaluation for Radiopharmaceuticals (OLINDA/EXM) .
Dr. Chih-Hsien Chang, 2024/11/27.

Special dates:
Mid-exam, 2024/10/22.
Final exam, 2024/12/17

六、成績考核(Evaluation)
1. 作業/參與｜Homework/ Participation, 30%
2. 期中考/期末考｜mid-exam/final exam, 50%
3. 專題 final project with oral presentation, 20%

根據本校公布之「大學教育場域AI協作、共學與素養培養指引」，本門課程採取有條件開放，說明如下

一、課程說明(Course Description)
This course introduces the essential physics in medical imaging, including image
quality, medical imaging informatics, diagnostic radiography, and nuclear
medicine. Medical imaging provides the anatomic and functional information from
human body. It helps radiologists to make diagnosis. Over the past decade,
considerable changes have occurred in medical imaging, such as images from
analog
(screen/film) to digital, a number of new technologies from research projects to
enter clinical use. This course also introduces the latest technologies in
medical
imaging, which offers the possibility of substantially reducing radiation dose
under keeping acceptable image quality.

docs.text:
一、 課程說明(Course Description)

本課程介紹放射廢棄物之處理、貯存、與處置之相關科學與工程。內容如下：

1. 放射性廢棄物管理的內容及基本原則
2. 放射性廢棄物的核種來源與特性
3. 放射性廢氣及廢液處理
4. 固態放射性廢棄物處理
5. 核電廠除污及除役技術
6. 低放廢棄物難測核種分析及比例因數
7. 低放廢棄物最終處置
9. 高放廢棄物最終處置(場址調查技術)
10. 高放廢棄物最終處置(場址工程建造技術)
11. 高放廢棄物最終處置(功能安全評估)
12. 核種遷移理論與分析
13. 放射性廢棄物處置與天然類比
14. 再處理、群分離及核轉換技術

二、指定用書(Text Books)
S. Nagasaki and S. Nakayama , Radioactive Waste Engineering and Management,
Springer, 2015.

三、參考書籍(References)
The geological disposal of nuclear waste; Neil A. Chapman and Ian G.
McKinley;1988

四、教學方式(Teaching Method)
1. 由教師編寫之講義課堂講授
2. 學生口頭專題報告
3. 討論

五、教學進度(Syllabus)
原則上每周一章

六、成績考核(Evaluation)
1. 上課與討論 10％

NES 561000 Structure Materials in Nuclear Power Systems
[ **This course will be offered biannually!]
[ **This course will be offered in English.]
[ **Video and electronic handout will be prepared for students who choose X-class
mode through this semester. However, they have to attend the mid-term exam and
final exam phyiscially at designated classroom.]

INSTRUCTOR: Kuan-Che Lan 藍貫哲
Office: LTM Building R615; TEL: 35566; Email: kclan@mx.nthu.edu.tw

Course Description
Introduction on the structural materials and issues of Light Water Reactors.
Students without background about materials science are welcome since
fundamental knowledge of material and radiation damage in materials will be
introduced in the beginning. Then materials and related issue from reactor
core, pressure vessel, steam generator and cooling system will be discussed.
Finally, advanced nuclear power system will be covered. This is an informative
course to learn nuclear materials in Taiwan and it’s definitely helpful for
people who plan to work in this field about nuclear engineering.

Text Books:
1. K. L. Murty, and I. Charit. An introduction to nuclear materials:
fundamentals and applications. John Wiley & Sons, 2013.
2. Roberts, J.T.A., Structural Materials in Nuclear Power Systems, Plenum
Press, 1981.

References:
1. Shah, V.N. and MacDonald, P.E., Eds., Aging and Life Extension of Major LWR
Components, Elsevier, New York, 1993.

Teaching Method:
Direct instruction with electronic handouts provided.

Syllabus:
Ch.1 Fundamental of Materials and Radiation Damage in Materials
Ch.2 Properties of Materials and Radiation Effects on Materials
Ch.3 Material and Problem in Light Water Reactor Plants
Ch.4 Core Materials and Cladding
Ch.5 Pressure Vessel Components
Ch.6 Steam Generator and Cooling System
Ch.7 Materials and Problems in Advanced Nuclear Power Systems

Evaluation:
Mid-term Exam 30%
Final Exam 30%
Homework 20%
Final Report 20%

一、課程說明(Course Description)
本學期體育課程安排以增進學生體適能能力及培養學生養成規律運動習慣為主。
針對大一新鮮人安排的體育課程包含兩大項：一為術科方面安排有：游泳、各項球類活動，期望透

本課程是運科系一年級上學期必修的課程，非運科系的同學請勿選課。

課程目的：
1.體驗身體活動的樂趣與內在回饋。
2.增進班上同學的人際互動與凝聚力。

本課程本學期的主要內容：
1. 主要課程有氧運動的體驗：慢跑，游泳。其餘課程，依照體育室安排場地上課。
2. 會安排校外參訪。會要求競技組的同學一起參加。會安排內灣郊山的踏青活動。

課程目標：
一、學會體適能、桌球、羽球的基本概念與技能。

3.森武（1990）：圖解桌球教室。台北巿/武陵出版社。
4.林貴福（1996）：基礎羽球教學與訓練。新竹市/國立新竹師範學院共同學科。

docs.text:
一、課程說明(Course Description)
1.從親身參與及練習過程中培養對運動的喜好，進而養成終身休閒活動之目的，並從中瞭解運動對
身體健康的好處。
2.急救課程訓練及AED醫療器材使用。
3.介紹體適能與健康的理論與觀念。
4.指導體適能檢測方法。
5.學會各種運動基本理論與技術，並享受運動比賽與欣賞樂趣。
6.瞭解各種運動之簡史、簡易規則及場地設備。
7.運動傷害之預防與處理。
8.培養參與體育活動團結合作之精神。

二、教學方式(Teaching Method)
講述法、動作示範、實際演練

課程說明、急救訓練
籃球（室外）
桌球
田徑
體適能
足球
重量訓練
羽球
棒壘球
游泳

四、成績考核(Evaluation)
1.上課出缺席 40% 見注意事項。
2.上課精神 40% 觀察學生上課參與情形，由教師主觀評分。
3.運動常識測驗 20% 筆試測驗。
注意事項：
1.上課不可著牛仔褲、涼鞋等不適宜運動之穿著；毛巾及開水請自備。
2.不得曠課 3 次(含)或缺席 4 次(含)，違者學期成績不及格。
3.點名後未到視為遲到，違者扣 1 分，超過第一節課鐘響者，扣 2 分。

備註：
1.請患有「心臟病、氣喘、癲癇、糖尿病、血友病、癌症、精神病等重大傷病或特殊疾病史」之同
學，主動向老師說明，課程內容得視同學學習狀況彈性調整。
2.為了安全考量，上課當天或上課中途身體有任何不適，請立即告知老師，停下來休息，不要勉強
運動。

一、 認知方面
(1)了解跆拳道運動的起源與運動現況。

大一體育

一、課程說明
此體育課程著重在於體育知識與常識的傳授，運動能力培養與運動道德的建立。大一新生透過體育
課程之運動項目的體驗學習，了解在各項運動所需體能與空間物理要素，並透過團隊合作與團隊策
略討論執行下，達到體育課程中互助合作策略運用的核心目標。並透過課程讓清大大一同學了解，
清華大學以體育為本的核心理念，讓體育能夠深入生活，運動能夠知所運用。

(一)透過課程執行培養運動喜好與習慣
(二)建立運動傷害預防與正確防護觀念
(三)急救課程訓練與AED醫療器材使用
(四)認識校園運動設施，了解操作與注意要點
(五)指導體適能檢測方法
(六)介紹體適能與各項運動所需技能素養
(七)各項運動規則與相關史實紀錄介紹
(八)建構運動策略執行與運動道德之培養
(九)團隊合作與團隊執行的建立

docs.text:
Course Description:
1. Familiarize students with the school's sports facilities and environment, and
emphasize potential risks associated with sports activities.
2. Improve physical fitness and promote overall well-being.
3. Enhance students' skills in various water sports.
4. Foster teamwork and sportsmanship.
5. Promote interpersonal interaction through sports activities.

Teaching Methods: Lectures, demonstrations, practical exercises, and active
participation.

Course Schedule: This is a tentative schedule; the actual schedule will be
finalized after the start of the semester based on available sports facilities.
Week 1: Basketball (outdoor basketball court). Course introduction, safety
guidelines, and grading policy.
Week 2: CPR and AED training (NTHU Delta Hall, B1 Lecture Hall).
Week 3: Physical fitness test (Gymnasium, 2nd floor).
Week 4: Volleyball (outdoor volleyball court).
Week 5: Soccer (playground/soccer field).
Week 6: National Day (holiday).
Week 7: Soccer (playground/soccer field).
Week 8: National Day holiday (make-up day).
Week 9: baseball/Softball (baseball field).
Week 10: baseball/Softball (baseball field).
Week 11: School Sports Day (mandatory attendance).
Week 12: Basketball/Volleyball (Gymnasium, 2nd floor).
Week 13: Basketball/Volleyball (Gymnasium, 2nd floor).
Week 14: Swimming (swimming pool).
Week 15: Swimming (swimming pool).
Week 16: Make-up test (Gymnasium).

Grading:
1. Attitude and Participation: 30%
2. Course Participation: 70%

Notes:
This course does not involve the use of AI.
Students with serious injuries, illnesses, or medical conditions should inform
the instructor to receive necessary assistance.
Students are not permitted to be absent during midterm and final exams.
Exceptions for official duties, illness, childbirth, death of a close relative,
or unforeseen circumstances beyond the student's control require supporting
documentation and instructor approval. The instructor's specific regulations
take precedence.

Leave Approval Authority:
1. Personal leave, sick leave, bereavement leave, and maternity leave: For up to
two days, the leave is approved by the course instructor; for more than three
days, the leave is approved by the course instructor and reviewed by the
department/program/class director.
2. Psychological leave and menstrual leave: These leaves are directly submitted
to the course instructor for review.
3. Indigenous cultural festival leave: After the Indigenous Student Resource
Center verifies the student's identity and the dates of the cultural festival as
announced by the Council of Indigenous Peoples, the leave is directly submitted
to the course instructor for review.
4. Official leave: For student clubs or teams, the leave is approved by the
student affairs office staff, the student affairs supervisor, and the dean of
students; for department/program activities, military service, or other
unclassified activities, the leave is approved by the department/program staff,
the department/program director, and the dean of the college; for official
business assignments by administrative units, the leave is approved by the
administrative unit staff, the second-level supervisor, and the first-level
supervisor, and a copy is provided to the course instructor for reference.

課程說明：
1. 認識學校運動環境、設施，並注意從事該運動之潛在風險。。
2. 提升身體適能，並促進身心健康。
3. 提升個人水上運動技能。
4. 展現團隊合作精神及競賽禮儀。
5. 透過體育運動，增進人際互動。

教學方式：講述說明、動作示範、實務操作、活動參與。

教學進度：本課程為暫訂課程待開學後依體育室場地安排上課。
第一週 籃球(室外籃球場)。課程內容、安全事項與成績考核說明。
第二週 心肺復甦術CPR、自動體外心臟電擊去顫器AED急救訓練(台達館璟B1德講堂)。
第三週 體適能測驗(體育館二樓)。
第四週 排球(室外排球場)。
第五週 足球(操場、足球場)。
第六週 國慶日。
第七週 足球(操場、足球場)。
第八週 臺灣光復暨金門古寧頭大捷紀念日補假。
第九週 棒壘球(棒球場)。
第十週 棒壘球(棒球場)。
第十一週 11/12全校運動會。
第十二週 籃球/排球(體育館二樓)。
第十三週 籃球/排球(體育館二樓)。
第十四週 游泳(游泳池)。
第十五週 游泳(游泳池)。
第十六週 補行測驗(體育館)。

成績考核：
1. 學習態度 30%
2. 課程參與 70%

注意事項：
本課程無涉及AI使用。
患有重大傷病或特殊病史之同學，請主動向授課老師說明以提供協助。
學生於期中、期末考試不得請假。但因公、急病、分娩、近親喪亡、臨時發生不可抗力或不可歸責於
當事人之因素，應檢附相關證明文件經任課教師同意。惟任課教師另有規定者，從其規定。

准假權責：
一、事假、病假、喪假、娩假：二日以內由任課教師核准；三日以上由任課教師核准、系/班（所）
主任（所長）備查。
二、心理假、生理假：逕送任課教師備查。
三、原住民族歲時祭儀假：由原住民族學生資源中心查核學生身分及行政院原住民族委員會公告之所
屬族群歲時祭儀日期通過後，逕送任課教師備查。
四、公假：學生社團或校隊由學務單位承辦人、學務單位主管、學生事務長核准；系（所）活動、兵
役或無法歸類之活動由系（所）單位承辦人、系/班（所）主任（所長）、學院院長核准；行政單位
因公派遣學生出任公務由行政單位承辦人、行政單位二級主管、行政單位一級主管核准，並提供任課
教師備查。

docs.name: 游泳初學
docs.text:
課程名稱：游泳-初學
課程目標：
本課程主要以未具備游泳能力之對象，提供動作學習及修正的練習，課程內容以捷泳及蛙泳為
主。
課程目標
包含：
1.增進游泳技術
2.建構基本水中自救能力
3.培養良好體能
4.培養學生終身運動習慣
5.認識競技游泳及賽事欣賞
5.以運動為橋樑建構人際關係

*課程綱要：
一、認知方面
1.了解游泳與提升體適能之間的關係。
2.了解正確的游泳姿勢對身體的重要。
3.了解影響游泳能力的因素。
二、情意方面
1.培養對游泳的興趣。
2.領會藉由運動達到舒壓的效果。
3.感受團隊運動中人際關係的互動。
三、技能方面
1.學會控制身體各部位。
2.學會基本動作並加以應用。
3.學會水中自救技巧
4.學會並修正捷泳及蛙泳的動作技巧
四、指定用書(Text Books)：
無
五、參考書籍(References)：
無
六、教學方式(Teaching Method)
1.暖身
2.水性培養
3.協調動作練習
4.分解動作練習
5.聯合動作練習
6.緩和休息
7.動作分析
8.綜合評論

*課程進度(Syllabus)
一、水性培養：
1.韻律呼吸
2.各式漂浮
3.搖櫓及踩水

二、水中自救技巧：
1.水中自救技巧介紹與練習。
2.訓練輔助器材介紹與使用。

三、 捷泳動作技術修正
1.捷泳分解與聯合動作練習。
2.捷泳動作技術分析

四、蛙泳動作技術修正
1.蛙泳分解與聯合動作練習。
2.蛙泳動作技術分析

五、綜合測驗：
1.動作影片拍攝
2.動作技術與分析
3.綜合技術測驗

成績考核(Evaluation)

一、課程說明(Course Description)
本課程主要為不諳水性或無法持續完成25公尺者，提供蛙式、基本仰泳（自救與救生）及仰式等動
作技術之學習。課程目標除能輕鬆游完50公尺以上距離外，並能培養游泳健身、水中自救與簡易救援之
概念和能力，以期領略游泳運動的樂趣，養成規律游泳運動的習慣。

二、指定用書(Text Books)

三、參考書籍(References)
溫宇紅、李文靜（2005）：游泳技術圖解。台北縣：諾亞文化出版社。
項國寧譯（2007）：輕鬆有效的魚式游泳。台北市：聯經出版事業股份有限公司。
劉煒（2009）：游泳。北京：北京師範大學出版社。

四、教學方式(Teaching Method)
1.動作說明.示範
2.分組練習
3.自主練習

五、教學進度(Syllabus)
韻律呼吸、游泳能力測驗
適應水性、蛙泳蹬夾腿(一)：個人動作
－蹬夾腿(二)：兩人協同
－蹬夾腿與換氣配合、划手練習
－划手與換氣配合
－聯合動作及轉身
測驗蛙泳
基本仰泳—仰漂、仰臥蛙腿
—手臂練習、聯合動作
仰式—打腿、划手練習
—簡易聯合與轉身
測驗仰姿游泳

六、成績考核(Evaluation)
1.全勤，並完成測驗且學習態度良好者，可得A+
2.倘遇下列情形，計分為：60分-（遲到-1；見習-2*1；早退-3；請假-4*2；缺課-7）+測驗30*3
*1：因例假並於第16週上課時除外；*2：代表學校、國家參加活動時除外
*3：蛙式50m（> 1:40s或 100m）；仰姿50m（不計時），各15分
3.實際授課1/3次數未下水，不予及格

一、課程說明
此體育課程以運動教育模式進行，著重在於分組團隊角色合作之應用，需要與組員有較多實際互動與
溝
通，透過排球競賽與情境，建構排球運動能力培養與團隊運動道德。排球課程的執行體驗學習，並透
過
團隊合作與團隊策略討論執行下，達到體育課程中互助合作策略運用的核心目標。並透過排球課程讓
同
學了解，清華大學以體育為本的核心理念，讓體育能夠深入生活，運動能夠知所運用。

docs.name: 跆拳道
docs.text:
一、課程說明(Course Description)

一、 認知方面
(1)了解跆拳道運動的起源與運動現況。
(2)認識跆拳道運動的特色與活動事項。
(3)了解跆拳道基本動作踢擊之要領與目的。
(4)運用跆拳道的基本動作於防身術之應用原
則。

二、 技能方面
(1)學會正確跆拳道基本足部動作技巧(前
踢、旋踢、側踢、下壓、後踢、後旋踢)。
(2)鍛鍊身體各部位機能----肌力、柔軟度、
心肺耐力、敏捷性、協調性和判斷力。
(3)運用跆拳道動作技巧發揮防身術之運用能
力。
(4)鍛鍊跆拳道足技基本動作(前踢、側踢、
下壓、旋踢、後踢、後旋踢)之擊破能力。

三、 情意方面
(1)培養對於跆拳道運動的興趣,並享受跆拳
道武術運動的參與樂趣。
(2)養成守法、負責、公正、勝不驕、敗不餒
之氣度並鍛鍊克服困難之意志與
互助合作之精神。
(3)學習自我防衛的技巧與觀念,建立健身與
防身的正確觀念。
(4)培養欣賞跆拳道運動競技之能力與體會跆
拳道力與美的美感經驗。

運動處方與健康 龍田種
力大圖書

福、盧淑雲合著 師大書苑發行
Essentials of Exercise Physiology
McARDLE, KATCH, KATCH Lea
&Febiger
Exercise Physiology
Brooks and Fahey
WILEYExercise in
Health and Disease Pollock,
M.L. et al. (1984)
Am. Review of Respiratory Disease
Edmunds, A.T. et al.(1978)
Exercise Prescription
SWAIN and LEUTHOLTZ Human
Kinetics
Publishers,Inc.
http://youtube.com 動作教學參考網站

第二週 足球球感與邊線球練習。

分組練習。五人制足球分組比賽。
第八週 期中測驗。
第九週 自由球(角球)與守門員動作介紹與練習。
自由球、罰球、角球與戰術配合操作。分組練習。五人制足球分組比賽。
第十週 團隊防守陣形介紹與練習：3-1、2-2、1-3、Power play。
分組練習。五人制足球分組比賽。
第十一週 團隊防守陣形練習：3-1、2-2、1-3、Power play。
分組練習。五人制足球分組比賽。

分組練習。五人制足球分組比賽。

分組練習。五人制足球分組比賽。

【Basic table tennis every week's course and schedule】
◎The 1st week
Introduce table tennis course.
Course's goals and routines.
Semester evaluation instructions.
Preparation in the beginning of the semesters.
◎The 2nd week
Basic ability evaluation.
Class to ability group.
Adapt to the studying course.
Acquainted with different classmates.
◎The 3rd week
Basic serving practice—No spin ball.
Table tennis regulations.
Practical practice of competition (up and down,funny,break through,challenging..)
◎The 4th week
Basic backhand push practice.
Doubles match practice.
◎The 5th week
Basic forehand drive practice.
Umpire's duty.
◎The 6th week
Forehand drive and backhand push combined practice.
Umpire's duty.
◎The 7th week
How to serve and receive backspin ball.
Chop the ball
◎The 8th week.

docs.text: 健走與慢跑教學大綱 教師：張祐華 Email：yhchang@mx.nthu.edu.tw 一、教學目標 1.認識健走與慢跑運動概念與知識，了解正確的運動方法與目的。 2.學習基本技巧並強化心肺功能，增進身體的肌肉與肌耐力等身體能力。 3.能享受運動的樂趣，藉以達到舒壓放鬆的效果，並建立身體意象之自信。 4.提升對健走與慢跑運動的參與動機，培養規律運動習慣。 二、教學內容 1.健走與慢跑動作講解 2.伸展操介紹 3.訓練法介紹 4.運動傷害防護講解 三、教學進度 週次 場地 授課內容 備註 1 操場 課程說明、成績考核、運動傷害預防處理介紹、熱身/伸展操之介紹與操作 2 操場 健走姿勢介紹「頭部、眼睛、身體、步伐」練習、校內健走、核心訓練 3 操場 健走姿勢練習與矯正、健走配速介紹與練習、校內健走、核心訓練 4 操場 健走姿勢練習與矯正、健走配速練習、校內健走、核心訓練 5 操場 健走姿勢練習與矯正、健走配速練習、校內健走、核心訓練 6 操場 18 尖山健走、核心訓練 7 操場 18 尖山健走、核心訓練 8 操場 800 公尺健走測驗 9 操場 各種路跑介紹、慢跑姿勢介紹與練習「頭部、眼睛、身體、步伐」、間歇訓 練介紹與練習、核心訓練 10 操場 慢跑姿勢練習、間歇訓練、核心訓練 11 操場 慢跑姿勢練習、法特雷克介紹與練習、核心訓練 12 操場 慢跑姿勢練習、法特雷克練習、核心訓練 13 操場 慢跑姿勢練習、配速跑介紹與練習、核心訓練 14 操場 慢跑姿勢練習、配速跑練習、核心訓練 15 操場 慢跑姿勢練習、配速跑練習、核心訓練 16 操場 800 公尺健走測驗 四、學習評量 1.課堂出席 60%(無故缺席四次該項目以零分計算) 2.術科檢定 20% 3.課堂執行狀況 20% 五、參考資料 1.鄭景峰(2016)。基礎全人健康與體適能。 2.林貴福(2016)。健身路跑訓練。 3.喬.普利歐/ 派翠克.米羅伊(2011)。跑步解剖學 六、注意事項 1.服裝-請著適當的運動服裝(運動服)即可；穿著運動鞋，勿穿拖鞋。 2.由於課程內容及上課方式，會校內外健走，請準時出席。 3.由於本課程將進行校園健走活動，若遲到並未能及時參與，將無法跟上課程進度，一律視為缺席 處理。

docs.text:
一、課程說明(Course Description)
(一) 透過身體活動與練習增加全身核心肌力的鍛鍊
(二) 學習自我筋膜放鬆與按摩,改善身體痠痛、強化核心肌群。
(三) 培養運動興趣和能力、養成規律運動之習慣。

二、教學方式(Teaching Method)
(一) 運動項目簡介、規則說明
(二) 講解、示範
(三) 分組、循環練習

三、教學進度(Syllabus)
週次日期 教學進度
第01週：課程介紹、核心肌力與體適能概述
第02週：核心肌群講解-(軀幹背面)，正面與背面主要核心肌群訓練
第03週：核心肌群講解-(臀腿)，站姿訓練

第07週：下/側腹訓練
第08週：全側腹訓練
第09週：期中考
第10週：核心肌群講解，背部交叉線訓練
第11週：核心肌群綜合動作訓練
第12週：核心肌群綜合動作訓練
第13週：核心肌群綜合動作訓練

第15週：運動按摩與肌肉筋膜放鬆
第16週：期末考
